passages.text: Then Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness, where for forty days He was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and when they had ended, He was hungry.
passages.sermon:
Jesus was full of the Holy Spirit.
He returned from the Jordan River.
The Holy Spirit led Jesus into the wilderness.
Jesus stayed in the wilderness for forty days.
During those forty days, the devil tempted Jesus.
Jesus did not eat anything during those days.
When the forty days ended, Jesus was hungry.
passages.original: Ἰησοῦς δὲ πλήρης Πνεύματος Ἁγίου ὑπέστρεψεν ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου καὶ ἤγετο ἐν τῷ Πνεύματι ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἡμέρας τεσσεράκοντα πειραζόμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ διαβόλου Καὶ οὐκ ἔφαγεν οὐδὲν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις καὶ συντελεσθεισῶν αὐτῶν ἐπείνασεν

passages.text: The devil said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”
passages.sermon:
The devil spoke to Jesus.
The devil challenged Jesus.
The devil said, "If you are the Son of God, speak to this stone."
The devil told Jesus to command the stone to become bread.
passages.original: Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ διάβολος Εἰ Υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰπὲ τῷ λίθῳ τούτῳ ἵνα γένηται ἄρτος

passages.text: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’”
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of God.
Jesus was full of the Holy Spirit.
Jesus answered the devil.
Jesus said, “It is written.”
Man shall not live on bread alone.
passages.original: Καὶ ἀπεκρίθη πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Γέγραπται ὅτι Οὐκ ἐπ’ ἄρτῳ μόνῳ ζήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος

passages.text: Then the devil led Him up to a high place and showed Him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.
passages.sermon:
The devil tempted Jesus in the wilderness.
The devil took Jesus to a high place.
The devil showed Jesus all the kingdoms of the world.
The devil did this in a single moment.
passages.original: Καὶ ἀναγαγὼν αὐτὸν ἔδειξεν αὐτῷ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας τῆς οἰκουμένης ἐν στιγμῇ χρόνου

passages.text: “I will give You authority over all these kingdoms and all their glory,” he said. “For it has been relinquished to me, and I can give it to anyone I wish.
passages.sermon:
The devil spoke to Jesus.
The devil said, “I will give you all this authority.
I will give you all the glory of these kingdoms.
This authority and glory have been given to me.
I can give them to anyone I want.”
passages.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ διάβολος Σοὶ δώσω τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην ἅπασαν καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐμοὶ παραδέδοται καὶ ᾧ ἐὰν θέλω δίδωμι αὐτήν

passages.text: So if You worship me, it will all be Yours.”
passages.sermon: The devil spoke to Jesus.\r\nThe devil offered Jesus a choice.\r\nThe devil said, “If you worship me, everything will belong to you.”
passages.original: σὺ οὖν ἐὰν προσκυνήσῃς ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ ἔσται σοῦ πᾶσα

passages.text: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the devil.
Jesus answered him.
Jesus said, “It is written.”
Jesus said, “Worship the Lord your God.”
Jesus said, “Serve only Him.”
passages.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Γέγραπται Προσκυνήσεις Κύριον τὸν Θεόν σου καὶ αὐτῷ μόνῳ λατρεύσεις

passages.text: Then the devil led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple. “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down from here.
passages.sermon:
The devil tempted Jesus.
The devil led Jesus to Jerusalem.
The devil took Jesus to the highest point of the temple.
The devil spoke to Jesus.
The devil said, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down from here.”
passages.original: Ἤγαγεν δὲ αὐτὸν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ ἔστησεν ἐπὶ τὸ πτερύγιον τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Εἰ Υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ Θεοῦ βάλε σεαυτὸν ἐντεῦθεν κάτω

passages.text: For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You to guard You carefully; and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’”
passages.sermon:
God gives commands to His angels about you.
God tells His angels to guard you carefully.
God’s angels will lift you up in their hands.
They will do this so you will not strike your foot against a stone.
passages.original: γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι Τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ ἐντελεῖται περὶ σοῦ τοῦ διαφυλάξαι σε καὶ ὅτι ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἀροῦσίν σε μή‿ ποτε προσκόψῃς πρὸς λίθον τὸν πόδα σου

passages.text: But Jesus answered, “It also says, ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the devil.
Jesus answered him.
Jesus said, “It is written.”
Jesus said, “Do not test the Lord your God.”
passages.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Εἴρηται Οὐκ ἐκπειράσεις Κύριον τὸν Θεόν σου

passages.text: When the devil had finished every temptation, he left Him until an opportune time.
passages.sermon:
The devil tempted Jesus in many ways.
The devil finished every temptation.
The devil left Jesus.
The devil planned to return at a better time.
passages.original: Καὶ συντελέσας πάντα πειρασμὸν ὁ διάβολος ἀπέστη ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἄχρι καιροῦ

passages.text: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and the news about Him spread throughout the surrounding region.
passages.sermon:
Jesus returned to Galilee.
He had the power of the Holy Spirit.
People heard about Jesus.
News about Him spread through the whole region.
passages.original: Καὶ ὑπέστρεψεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ Πνεύματος εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν καὶ φήμη ἐξῆλθεν καθ’ ὅλης τῆς περιχώρου περὶ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: He taught in their synagogues and was glorified by everyone.
passages.sermon: Jesus taught in their synagogues.\r\nEveryone honored Him.\r\n
passages.original: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδίδασκεν ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν δοξαζόμενος ὑπὸ πάντων

passages.text: Then Jesus came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up. As was His custom, He entered the synagogue on the Sabbath. And when He stood up to read, the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to Him. Unrolling it, He found the place where it was written: “The Spirit of the Lord is on Me, because He has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to release the oppressed, to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus grew up in Nazareth.
He came to Nazareth.
Jesus had a custom.
He entered the synagogue on the Sabbath.
He stood up to read.
Someone gave Him the scroll of the prophet Isaiah.
Jesus unrolled the scroll.
He found a place in the scroll.
This place had these words written:
“The Spirit of the Lord is on Me.
The Lord has anointed Me.
He anointed Me to preach good news to the poor.
He sent Me to proclaim liberty to the captives.
He sent Me to give recovery of sight to the blind.
He sent Me to release the oppressed.
He sent Me to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.”
passages.original: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ναζαρά οὗ ἦν τεθραμμένος καὶ εἰσῆλθεν κατὰ τὸ εἰωθὸς αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων εἰς τὴν συναγωγήν καὶ ἀνέστη ἀναγνῶναι καὶ ἐπεδόθη αὐτῷ βιβλίον τοῦ προφήτου Ἠσαΐου καὶ ἀναπτύξας τὸ βιβλίον εὗρεν τὸν τόπον οὗ ἦν γεγραμμένον Πνεῦμα Κυρίου ἐπ’ ἐμέ Οὗ εἵνεκεν ἔχρισέν με Εὐαγγελίσασθαι πτωχοῖς Ἀπέσταλκέν με κηρῦξαι αἰχμαλώτοις ἄφεσιν Καὶ τυφλοῖς ἀνάβλεψιν Ἀποστεῖλαι τεθραυσμένους ἐν ἀφέσει Κηρῦξαι ἐνιαυτὸν Κυρίου δεκτόν

passages.text: Then He rolled up the scroll, returned it to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on Him, and He began by saying, “Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus was in the synagogue at Nazareth.
He had just read from the scroll of the prophet Isaiah.
He rolled up the scroll.
He gave the scroll back to the attendant.
He sat down.
Everyone in the synagogue looked at Him.
All eyes were fixed on Jesus.
Jesus began to speak to them.
He said, “Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”
passages.original: Καὶ πτύξας τὸ βιβλίον ἀποδοὺς τῷ ὑπηρέτῃ ἐκάθισεν καὶ πάντων οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἦσαν ἀτενίζοντες αὐτῷ ἤρξατο δὲ λέγειν πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὅτι Σήμερον πεπλήρωται ἡ γραφὴ αὕτη ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν ὑμῶν

passages.text: All spoke well of Him and marveled at the gracious words that came from His lips. “Isn’t this the son of Joseph?” they asked.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke in the synagogue at Nazareth.
He had grown up in Nazareth.
Everyone there spoke well of Jesus.
They were amazed at His gracious words.
These words came from His mouth.
They asked, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”
passages.original: Καὶ πάντες ἐμαρτύρουν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ἐπὶ τοῖς λόγοις τῆς χάριτος τοῖς ἐκπορευομένοις ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔλεγον Οὐχὶ υἱός ἐστιν Ἰωσὴφ οὗτος

passages.text: Jesus said to them, “Surely you will quote this proverb to Me: ‘Physician, heal yourself! Do here in Your hometown what we have heard that You did in Capernaum.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the people in the synagogue.
He said, “You will surely say this proverb to Me.
‘Physician, heal yourself.’
You will ask Me to do here in My hometown what you heard I did in Capernaum.”
passages.original: Καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Πάντως ἐρεῖτέ μοι τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην Ἰατρέ θεράπευσον σεαυτόν ὅσα ἠκούσαμεν γενόμενα εἰς τὴν Καφαρναοὺμ ποίησον καὶ ὧδε ἐν τῇ πατρίδι σου

passages.text: Then He added, “Truly I tell you, no prophet is accepted in his hometown.
passages.sermon: Jesus spoke to the people in His hometown.\r\nHe said, “Truly, I tell you this.\r\nNo prophet is accepted in his own hometown.”
passages.original: Εἶπεν δέ Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς προφήτης δεκτός ἐστιν ἐν τῇ πατρίδι αὐτοῦ

passages.text: But I tell you truthfully that there were many widows in Israel in the time of Elijah, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and great famine swept over all the land.
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the people in the synagogue.
He told them the truth.
He said there were many widows in Israel.
This was during the days of Elijah.
At that time, Elijah was a prophet in Israel.
The sky was closed for three and a half years.
No rain fell during that time.
A great famine came over all the land.
Everyone in the land suffered from the famine.
passages.original: ἐπ’ ἀληθείας δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν πολλαὶ χῆραι ἦσαν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἠλίου ἐν τῷ Ἰσραήλ ὅτε ἐκλείσθη ὁ οὐρανὸς ἐπὶ ἔτη τρία καὶ μῆνας ἕξ ὡς ἐγένετο λιμὸς μέγας ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

passages.text: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to the widow of Zarephath in Sidon.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of God.
God did not send Elijah to any widow in Israel.
God sent Elijah only to one widow.
This widow lived in Zarephath.
Zarephath was a town in Sidon.
The widow in Zarephath received Elijah.
passages.original: καὶ πρὸς οὐδεμίαν αὐτῶν ἐπέμφθη Ἠλίας εἰ μὴ εἰς Σάρεπτα τῆς Σιδωνίας πρὸς γυναῖκα χήραν

passages.text: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet. Yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian.”
passages.sermon:
Elisha was a prophet in Israel.
Many people in Israel had leprosy during Elisha’s time.
None of these lepers in Israel were healed.
Only Naaman was healed.
Naaman was a Syrian.
passages.original: καὶ πολλοὶ λεπροὶ ἦσαν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ Ἐλισαίου τοῦ προφήτου καὶ οὐδεὶς αὐτῶν ἐκαθαρίσθη εἰ μὴ Ναιμὰν ὁ Σύρος

passages.text: On hearing this, all the people in the synagogue were enraged.
passages.sermon: Jesus spoke in the synagogue.\r\nThe people listened to His words.\r\nAll the people in the synagogue became very angry when they heard this.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν πάντες θυμοῦ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἀκούοντες ταῦτα

passages.text: They got up, drove Him out of the town, and led Him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw Him over the cliff.
passages.sermon:
The people in the synagogue became very angry at Jesus.
They stood up.
They forced Jesus out of the town.
They led Jesus to the edge of a hill.
The town was built on this hill.
They wanted to throw Jesus off the cliff.
passages.original: καὶ ἀναστάντες ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτὸν ἕως ὀφρύος τοῦ ὄρους ἐφ’ οὗ ἡ πόλις ᾠκοδόμητο αὐτῶν ὥστε κατακρημνίσαι αὐτόν

passages.text: But Jesus passed through the crowd and went on His way.
passages.sermon:
Jesus was there.
\r\nThe people in the synagogue were angry.
\r\nThey tried to harm Jesus.
\r\nJesus walked through the middle of the crowd.
\r\nHe went on His way.
passages.original: αὐτὸς δὲ διελθὼν διὰ μέσου αὐτῶν ἐπορεύετο

passages.text: Then He went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath He began to teach the people.
passages.sermon:
Jesus went to Capernaum.
Capernaum is a town in Galilee.
Jesus began to teach the people there.
He taught them on the Sabbath.
passages.original: Καὶ κατῆλθεν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ πόλιν τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἦν διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς σάββασιν

passages.text: They were astonished at His teaching, because His message had authority.
passages.sermon: Jesus taught the people.\r\nHis teaching amazed them.\r\nHis message had authority.
passages.original: καὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐν ἐξουσίᾳ ἦν ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ

passages.text: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by the spirit of an unclean demon. He cried out in a loud voice, “Ha! What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
passages.sermon:
Jesus was in the synagogue.
A man was there.
This man had an unclean demon.
The demon controlled the man.
The man cried out loudly.
He said, “Ha! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth?”
He said, “Have you come to destroy us?”
He said, “I know who you are.”
He said, “You are the Holy One of God.”
passages.original: Καὶ ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ ἦν ἄνθρωπος ἔχων πνεῦμα δαιμονίου ἀκαθάρτου καὶ ἀνέκραξεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ Ἔα τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί Ἰησοῦ Ναζαρηνέ ἦλθες ἀπολέσαι ἡμᾶς οἶδά σε τίς εἶ ὁ Ἅγιος τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: But Jesus rebuked the demon. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!” At this, the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without harming him.
passages.sermon:
Jesus was present in the synagogue.
A man there had an unclean demon.
Jesus spoke directly to the demon.
Jesus rebuked the demon.
Jesus said, “Be silent.”
Jesus said, “Come out of him.”
The demon obeyed Jesus.
The demon threw the man down in front of everyone.
The demon came out of the man.
The demon did not harm the man.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων Φιμώθητι καὶ ἔξελθε ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ῥίψαν αὐτὸν τὸ δαιμόνιον εἰς τὸ μέσον ἐξῆλθεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ μηδὲν βλάψαν αὐτόν

passages.text: All the people were overcome with amazement and asked one another, “What is this message? With authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
passages.sermon:
Jesus was in the synagogue.
He commanded an unclean spirit to leave a man.
All the people saw this.
Everyone felt great amazement.
They spoke to each other.
They said, “What is this message?”
They saw that Jesus used authority and power.
He gave orders to unclean spirits.
The unclean spirits obeyed Him and came out.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο θάμβος ἐπὶ πάντας καὶ συνελάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους λέγοντες Τίς ὁ λόγος οὗτος ὅτι ἐν ἐξουσίᾳ καὶ δυνάμει ἐπιτάσσει τοῖς ἀκαθάρτοις πνεύμασιν καὶ ἐξέρχονται

passages.text: And the news about Jesus spread throughout the surrounding region.
passages.sermon:
Jesus performed miracles.
People saw what Jesus did.
People talked about Jesus.
News about Jesus spread everywhere nearby.
passages.original: καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο ἦχος περὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς πάντα τόπον τῆς περιχώρου

passages.text: After Jesus had left the synagogue, He went to the home of Simon, whose mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever. So they appealed to Jesus on her behalf, and He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. And she got up at once and began to serve them.
passages.sermon:
Jesus left the synagogue.
He went to Simon’s house.
Simon’s mother-in-law was there.
She was suffering from a high fever.
They asked Jesus to help her.
Jesus stood over her.
He rebuked the fever.
The fever left her.
She got up at once.
She began to serve them.
passages.original: Ἀναστὰς δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς συναγωγῆς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος πενθερὰ δὲ τοῦ Σίμωνος ἦν συνεχομένη πυρετῷ μεγάλῳ καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν περὶ αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπιστὰς ἐπάνω αὐτῆς ἐπετίμησεν τῷ πυρετῷ καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτήν παραχρῆμα δὲ ἀναστᾶσα διηκόνει αὐτοῖς

passages.text: At sunset, all who were ill with various diseases were brought to Jesus, and laying His hands on each one, He healed them.
passages.sermon:
Jesus was a healer.
At sunset, people brought all the sick to Jesus.
These people suffered from many different diseases.
Jesus laid His hands on each sick person.
Jesus healed every one of them.
passages.original: Δύνοντος δὲ τοῦ ἡλίου ἅπαντες ὅσοι εἶχον ἀσθενοῦντας νόσοις ποικίλαις ἤγαγον αὐτοὺς πρὸς αὐτόν ὁ δὲ ἑνὶ ἑκάστῳ αὐτῶν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπιτιθεὶς ἐθεράπευεν αὐτούς

passages.text: Demons also came out of many people, shouting, “You are the Son of God!” But He rebuked the demons and would not allow them to speak, because they knew He was the Christ.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of God and the Christ.
Many people had demons inside them.
The demons came out of these people.
The demons shouted, “You are the Son of God!”
Jesus rebuked the demons.
He did not allow the demons to speak.
The demons knew Jesus was the Christ.
passages.original: ἐξήρχετο δὲ καὶ δαιμόνια ἀπὸ πολλῶν κραυγάζοντα καὶ λέγοντα ὅτι Σὺ εἶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἐπιτιμῶν οὐκ εἴα αὐτὰ λαλεῖν ὅτι ᾔδεισαν τὸν Χριστὸν αὐτὸν εἶναι

passages.text: At daybreak, Jesus went out to a solitary place, and the crowds were looking for Him. They came to Him and tried to keep Him from leaving.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of God.
At daybreak, Jesus left.
He went to a solitary place.
Crowds searched for Jesus.
The crowds found Him.
They came to Jesus.
They tried to keep Jesus from leaving them.
passages.original: Γενομένης δὲ ἡμέρας ἐξελθὼν ἐπορεύθη εἰς ἔρημον τόπον καὶ οἱ ὄχλοι ἐπεζήτουν αὐτόν καὶ ἦλθον ἕως αὐτοῦ καὶ κατεῖχον αὐτὸν τοῦ μὴ πορεύεσθαι ἀπ’ αὐτῶν

passages.text: But Jesus told them, “I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns as well, because that is why I was sent.”
passages.sermon: Jesus spoke to the people.\r\nHe said, “I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to other towns also.\r\nGod sent me for this purpose.”
passages.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς ὅτι Καὶ ταῖς ἑτέραις πόλεσιν εὐαγγελίσασθαί με δεῖ τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅτι ἐπὶ τοῦτο ἀπεστάλην

passages.text: And He continued to preach in the synagogues of Judea.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the subject.
Jesus preached.
He preached in the synagogues.
He preached in the synagogues of Judea.
He continued to preach there.
passages.original: Καὶ ἦν κηρύσσων εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς τῆς Ἰουδαίας
